_note: Illustrative example: an anonymised App Store-billed fitness app. Scores follow references/scoring.md; numbers in 'evidence' come from references/evidence.md.
subtitle: Health & Fitness · App Store billing · US + UK
verdict: Easy to find and hands off to Apple, but the plan-switch screen hides cancel under a big Keep button and every reason gets the same discount.

items.pattern: Cancel stays visible next to every offer
items.test: Make 'Cancel subscription' a peer button under the offer instead of grey text below the fold.
items.evidence: California ARL: save offers only with a click-to-cancel link shown at the same time (rule)

items.test: Send 'not using it' to a cheaper tier and 'too expensive' to the annual plan; 'other' goes straight to Apple.
items.evidence: Reason-matched offers, 47% saved (#C6, directional, web). Hypothesis on mobile

items.test: Replace the generic benefits list with the user's own month: workouts done, programmes saved.
items.evidence: Observed (several fitness apps); no public test

duration_note: Durations assume 400 cancel-flow entries a day and a 15% save rate, for a 10% relative change. Illustrative inputs.
